authority_boundary: Solidigm's own newsroom release is primary for Solidigm's shipment-history statement and product stage; the claim is not independently audited here.

claim_relevant_segments.cumulative_qlc_shipments: more than 100EB (exabytes) of QLC-based product shipped since 2018

precision_guard: The 100EB figure is cumulative Solidigm-reported QLC-based product shipment volume and is not an industry total, annual 2024 shipment figure, enterprise-only unit count, installed base, or AI-attributable demand quantity. The 122TB product's sampling status must not be conflated with the cumulative shipment history.
researcher_paraphrase: By the November 2024 announcement, Solidigm reported cumulative QLC-based product shipments above 100 exabytes since 2018, while the newly announced 122TB drive itself was still only sampling.
source_title: Solidigm Extends AI Portfolio Leadership with the Introduction of 122TB Drive
